--- title: "Outdoor Time and Sun Protection Dashboard" author: "Anh Lam" format: dashboard: orientation: rows scrolling: true engine: knitr --- # Overview ## Row

This dashboard explores outdoor time and sun protection behaviors among adults ages 20–59 using NHANES data.

## Row {height="20%"} ### Participants ::: {.cell content='valuebox'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $title [1] "Participants" $value [1] "4,867" $subtitle [1] "Adults ages 20–59" $icon [1] "people" ``` ::: ::: ### Median Outdoor Time ::: {.cell content='valuebox'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $title [1] "Median Outdoor Time" $value [1] "60 min" $subtitle [1] "On a work or school day" $icon [1] "clock" ``` ::: ::: ### Regular Sunscreen Use ::: {.cell content='valuebox'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $title [1] "Regular Sunscreen Users" $value [1] "20.4%" $subtitle [1] "Use sunscreen always or most of the time" $icon [1] "sun" ``` ::: ::: ## Row {height="55%"} ### Outdoor Time by Education ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Quarto-Dashboard_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=768} ::: ::: # Sunscreen Use ## Row {heigh="60%"} ### Regular Sunscreen Use by Gender ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Quarto-Dashboard_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=528} ::: ::: ### Sunscreen Use Summary ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |Gender |Regular Sunscreen Use | |:------|:---------------------| |Male |11.3% | |Female |29% | ::: ::: # Predicting ## Row {height="45%"} ### Model Performance ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Test Data Performance |Model | RMSPE| MAE| Validated R²| |:-----------|------:|------:|------------:| |Big Model | 157.15| 100.46| 0.14| |Small Model | 165.53| 104.73| 0.05| ::: ::: ### Key Finding The Big Model had lower prediction error and a higher $R^2$ than the Smaller Model. However, both models had significant prediction errors, which suggests that education and the demographic and sunscreen variables explain only a limited amount of variation in outdoor time. # About the Data ## Row {height="50%"} ### Data This dashboard uses data from the **NHANES 2017–March 2020 Pre-Pandemic cycle**. The analysis focuses on adults ages 20–59 who completed the examination. The dashboard examines outdoor time on work or school days, education level, gender, and regular sunscreen use. ### Variables **Outdoor Time:** Minutes spent outdoors on a typical work or school day. **Education:** Less than high school, High school/GED, Some college/AA, or College graduate or above. **Gender:** Male or Female. **Regular Sunscreen Use:** Participants who reported using sunscreen always or most of the time were classified as regular sunscreen users. ```{=html} ```
